name: Trellus
long_description: Trellus is a Chrome extension that power dials or parallel dials up to five lines inside the CRM or sales engagement platform a sales team already uses, and saves each call's outcome, notes and callback back to the record the rep called from. Reps rehearse objections with AI practice calls, and teams on the Business plan add real-time AI coaching, team analytics and a virtual sales floor. Plans start at $99.99 per seat per month.
one_liner: Power and parallel dialing with AI coaching, inside your CRM
